item.title: Naruto Sea Bream: Firm-Fleshed Prized Tai — Guide
item.description: Naruto sea bream (Naruto-dai) is some of the most highly prized tai in Japan, and its quality comes directly from the whirlpools. Living in the fast, turbulent tidal currents of the Naruto Strait, the fish must swim constantly against the powerful flow, developing exceptionally firm, lean, muscular flesh with a superb texture and clean, sweet flavour. It is at its very best in spring, the ‘cherry-blossom sea bream’ season, when the fish are plump before spawning.
